_header: Curated MCP client catalog for noc-agent (consumer side, read-only).
Hub: initMAX zabbix-mcp-server v1.36.1 in zbx-in-docker (loopback 127.0.0.1:8080, read_only, ~35 tools). This repo never touches the hub config; it only declares which tools L2 may request.
Budget: 15-25 tools max per token, never the full ~237-tool catalog (arch doc: full schemas cost ~100k tokens per turn).

IN: read-only getters (*_get) for daily triage (operator) plus diagnostics/analytics/reporting (technician). ALL tools take FLAT args on hub 1.36.1 (verified 2026-10-07: the 'params' wrapper is silently ignored, filters included); report_generate is PDF-only.

OUT: every write (*_create/update/delete, event_acknowledge, maintenance/sla write ops), raw_api_call (bypasses the read-only gate), and user/token/script/admin tools. Defense in depth: the hub enforces read_only at the gate; this list only shrinks what L2 can ask for.

Name verification status (2026-09-26): problem_active_get, host_status_get and host_get were called against the live lab hub during the Fase 2 spike; the remaining names follow the same <resource>_<qualifier>_get convention. Re-validate against a live tools/list once a read-only bearer is available; mcp/catalog.py:validate_catalog() enforces count and read-only shape, not hub existence.

operator.name: problem_active_get
operator.why: Daily triage baseline: active problems. Verified against the lab hub in the Fase 2 spike.

operator.name: event_get
operator.why: Event detail behind a problem (clock, severity, objectids) for manual correlation.

operator.name: trigger_get
operator.why: Trigger state/expression to tell firing apart from misconfigured triggers.

operator.name: host_get
operator.why: Host inventory baseline. Referenced in the Fase 2 spike write-block check.

operator.name: host_status_get
operator.why: Per-host availability/health summary. Verified against the lab hub in the Fase 2 spike.

operator.name: hostgroup_get
operator.why: Scope triage by host group before drilling into individual hosts.

operator.name: item_get
operator.why: See what is actually monitored on a host (key, delay, value type).

operator.name: history_get
operator.why: Raw recent values behind a spike, with an explicit limit.

operator.name: trend_get
operator.why: Aggregated hourly/daily trends for 'since when' questions without pulling raw history.

operator.name: service_get
operator.why: Service tree / SLA view for impact wording in operator replies.

technician.name: graph_get
technician.why: Graphs for diagnosis. Lab note: needs frontend credentials in hub config; kept because it is read-only.

technician.name: dashboard_get
technician.why: Read dashboards instead of re-describing state that already has a view.

technician.name: map_get
technician.why: Network maps for blast-radius reading during incidents.

technician.name: maintenance_get
technician.why: Read maintenance windows so suppressed problems are not mis-triaged.

technician.name: alert_get
technician.why: Alert dispatch history: who was already notified about what.

technician.name: sla_get
technician.why: SLA/SLO figures for technician-level impact assessment.

technician.name: discoveryrule_get
technician.why: Read discovery rules to explain auto-created hosts/items.

technician.name: anomaly_detect
technician.why: Extension analytics: anomaly detection. Takes FLAT args (no params wrapper).

technician.name: capacity_forecast
technician.why: Extension analytics: capacity forecast. Takes FLAT args (no params wrapper).

technician.name: report_generate
technician.why: Extension reporting, PDF-only (no xlsx). Kept in technician role because reports leave the chat.

excluded.notes: Writes are blocked at the hub read_only gate; excluding them here keeps L2 prompts small and prevents accidental requests. raw_api_call is excluded because it bypasses scoping. Graph generation stays (read); graph/maintenance/sla writes stay out.
